events.verdict: Vucevic (ORL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Harris (BKN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Isaac (ORL) does not impede Allen (BKN) during the rebound and he makes incidental leg to leg contact on his landing.
Allen (BKN) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Fournier (ORL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Allen (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position on Vucevic (ORL) in the post.
Vucevic (ORL) briefly grasps the arm of Allen (BKN) off ball that does not affect his ability to defend the pass in the post.
Carroll (BKN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Allen (BKN) disengages from the screen on Isaac (ORL) and the two players make incidental leg to leg contact.
Fournier (ORL) cleanly steals the ball from Harris (BKN) on the pass.

Ross (ORL) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Harris (BKN) and cleanly blocks the shot.
